entities.summary: Swami Nigamananda Paramahansa was an Indian yogi, guru and mystic in Eastern India. He is associated with the Shakta tradition and a spiritual master of vedanta, tantra, yoga, and prema or bhakti. His followers referred to him as Thakura. Nigamananda Paramahansa was a philosophers & thinkers from Kutabpur (1880-08-19, Kutabpur–1935-11-29). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
